name: Slice 2: Layout scaling and responsive panel sizes

comments.text: Multi-selection inspector: the (mixed) label suffix pushed fields out of the panel; now a short asterisk. Wider scaling work still open.

Checked at 1280x720: the editor window is a fixed 1680x980 logical, so on a smaller display it overflows and cuts off the panels. The window is resizable and the splits adapt. Fix needs SDL display bounds bindings (SDL_GetPrimaryDisplay, SDL_GetDisplayUsableBounds) in penumbra-ui-engine's SdlBindings and SdlWindow so the first size can be clamped to the display; that is a change in penumbra-ui-engine, not in the editor.
